operators.name: cumprod
semantics: Computes torch.cumprod along the given dim.
For dim=0, each output[a,b,c] = product over i<=a of input[i,b,c], with b in [0,3), c in [0,4).
Preserves input shape, dtype (float32), device (cuda) and strides semantics.
The custom op must support strided tensors without requiring contiguity.
Cumulative product along dimension 0 of input tensor of shape (8192, 3, 4).
For each slice (i, j, k), output[i,j,k] = input[0,j,k] * input[1,j,k] * ... * input[i,j,k].
The result has the same shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=cuda, stride [12,4,1].
Returns the result of cumprod unchanged. No additional computation.
